executive_summary: The nano-pdf skill edits PDFs using natural-language instructions, introducing risks such as prompt injection and memory poisoning. Implement input validation and sanitization, and follow memory handling best practices to mitigate these risks.
skill_purpose_analysis: The nano-pdf skill is designed to edit PDFs using natural-language instructions, which inherently involves processing user-supplied text as instructions.
remediation_priority: Implement input validation and sanitization, and follow memory handling best practices.

vulnerabilities.title: Prompt Injection Susceptibility
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Change the title to 'Q3 Results' and fix the typo in the subtitle
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill processes user-supplied text as instructions without proper sanitization, allowing prompt injection.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker crafts a malicious PDF name and content to inject unwanted commands into the tool.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement input validation and sanitization to prevent unintended command execution.

vulnerabilities.title: Memory Poisoning
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Use `nano-pdf` to apply edits to a specific page in a PDF using a natural-language instruction.
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill does not explicitly mention memory handling best practices, leaving potential for memory poisoning attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker crafts a malicious PDF to manipulate the agent's memory and influence future behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add explicit memory handling best practices to the skill documentation.

clawhub_summary: The nano-pdf skill is a simple, safe-to-use CLI tool for editing PDFs using natural-language instructions. It shows internal consistency and follows best practices in all five safety categories.
clawhub_assessment: The nano-pdf skill is a benign CLI tool for editing PDFs using natural-language instructions. It is internally consistent and follows best practices in all five safety categories. Users should still verify that the tool's behavior matches their expectations and ensure that the 'nano-pdf' binary is safe to use in their environment. Note that the tool's behavior depends on the underlying 'nano-pdf' library, so users should be cautious when using it with untrusted or sensitive data.
clawhub_purpose_capability_desc: The name, description, and code of the nano-pdf skill are consistent and focused on editing PDFs with natural-language instructions. There are no undisclosed capabilities.
clawhub_instruction_scope_desc: The runtime instructions of the nano-pdf skill are tightly scoped to the stated purpose. They avoid reading unrelated system files, contacting unexpected external endpoints, or treating retrieved content as executable instructions.
clawhub_install_mechanism_desc: The nano-pdf skill does not have a runtime install mechanism. It uses only bundled code and clearly declared dependencies, ensuring a safe and predictable installation process.
clawhub_credentials_desc: The nano-pdf skill does not handle API keys, secrets, or authentication tokens. It does not hardcode or log/transmit credentials, making it safe in this category.
clawhub_persistence_privilege_desc: The nano-pdf skill does not modify agent settings, other skills, or system-wide configuration. It does not request elevated privileges beyond what the task requires, and it writes data only within its declared workspace.
